selection: Start with all 306 historically selected plans, then retire the 21 with both engines timed out and the user-specified JOB 10a right-deep COUNT query after its measured speedup remained below 0.7x. On 2026-10-15, additionally retire the minimum-speedup TPC-H and JOB queries by explicit user request. Keep 282 selected plans, including six three-table queries and four DuckDB-only timeouts. Start with 65 COST_DUCKDB_BETTER controls chosen by family, tier, shape, source, size and query type; retain all 23 non-TPC-DS controls and 16 TPC-DS controls after source-pattern/tree-shape deduplication. The control selection does not rank measured runtime or speedup. Other fallbacks remain archived. This is plan-selection- and outcome-conditioned curation, not an unbiased workload sample.

control_deduplication.rule: Smaller groups first; balance semantic tiers; stable SHA256(revision + query_id) tie-break. No timing or speedup ranking.
